title: KScript project settings (kscript.json)
description: Settings for kscript serve, kscript check, kscript fmt and the KScript language server. Commands look for kscript.json in the folder they work on and its parents.

packages.description: Packages every script in the project uses without an <import>. KScript.Core is always imported.

serve.description: Defaults for kscript serve. Options on the command line win.

root.description: The site folder, relative to kscript.json. Its files and folders are the site's URLs.

host.description: localhost, an IP address to listen on, or * for every address.

lint.description: Used by kscript check and by the editor (language server).

include.description: Files kscript check looks at, as globs relative to kscript.json. .xml files that start with <kscript> are always included.

exclude.description: Files and folders that are never checked, by kscript check or the editor. A name without / (such as _templates) matches anywhere; drafts/** matches a folder.

rules.description: Severity per diagnostic code (KS3003) or code prefix (KS3*). The longest match wins.

warningsAsErrors.description: Make kscript check fail on warnings too (same as --warnaserror).

app.description: Used by kscript app build, which packages a script as a desktop app.

main.description: The script the app runs, relative to kscript.json. Usually one whose root is <KScript.Window>.

name.description: The app's name in the Dock, Start menu or launcher. Defaults to the project's name.

id.description: A reverse-DNS id such as com.example.lifelab (the macOS bundle id).

icon.description: An icon file relative to kscript.json: .icns for macOS, .ico for Windows, .png for Linux.

include.description: The test files kscript test runs, as globs relative to kscript.json.

exclude.description: Files and folders that are never run as tests.

timeout.description: Seconds one test may run before it fails (0 for no limit). timeout="..." on a <test> and --timeout win.

packages.description: Packages every test file imports, on top of the project's packages. KScript.Test is always imported in test files.

format.description: Used by kscript fmt and the editor's Format Document. Values set here win over the editor's tab settings.

indent.description: Spaces per indent level, or "tab" to indent with tabs.

tabWidth.description: With "indent": "tab", how many columns a tab counts as when lining up existing text.

printWidth.description: A start tag with several attributes that would run past this column gets one attribute per line.

maxBlankLines.description: Blank lines kept in a row; extra ones are removed.

endOfLine.description: Line endings to write. auto keeps the ones each file already uses.

preserve.description: Elements whose content is kept exactly as written, on top of <pre>, <textarea>, <script>, <style> and CDATA sections.

include.description: Files kscript fmt formats in a project folder, as globs relative to kscript.json. .xml files that start with <kscript> are always included; Markdown pages are never reformatted.

exclude.description: Files and folders kscript fmt leaves alone.
